description: CV and trigger expander for UZZ; it goes immediately to the left of the UZZ it controls

inputs.text: Adds to the UZZ step count at a volt per step, the total limited to 1 to 16 steps
Adds to the first step of the active window at a volt per step, the total limited to steps 1 to 16
Adds to the traversal order at a volt per order, counted Pendulum, Backward, Forward, Random, Drunk, Ping-Pong, Odd/Even, Jump, Converge, Diverge
Selects a position of the active window directly, 0V for its first position and 10V for its last, which bypasses the traversal order and plays Skip positions silently
Adds to the clock ratio at a volt per entry in the ratio list, the total limited to the ends of that list
Adds to the swing, 5V covering the whole 0 to 60% range from a knob at zero, the total limited to that range
Adds to the global probability, 10V for 100 percentage points either way, the total limited to 0 to 100%
Holds the direction reversed while it is at 1V or above, swapping Forward and Backward and leaving the other eight orders alone
A rising trigger clears all sixteen stored accumulator offsets without moving the sequence or changing any knob
A rising trigger moves every step's complete contents one position forward inside the active window, wrapping round
A rising trigger moves every step's complete contents one position backward inside the active window, wrapping round

notes: the green lamp at the top lights when a UZZ is found immediately to the right; with it dark, none of these jacks reaches anything.
an unpatched jack adds nothing, and the rotations move MODE, PITCH, OCT, DUR, MOD1, MOD2, PROB and the stored accumulator offsets together.
